title: What happens to your videos
intro: A short, practical overview of where your files go, who can see them and how long they stay. The full details are in the [Privacy Policy](/privacy).

summary.title: Stored in Europe
summary.body: Your files are kept in Google Cloud in the EU, your account and projects in Supabase in Zurich.

summary.title: Private to you
summary.body: Your uploads and exports are only served to your own signed-in account.

summary.title: Deleted on schedule
summary.body: Free: {{freeDays}} days after the last edit. Creator: {{creatorDays}} days. Pro: while subscribed. We email you 24 hours before.

summary.title: Never used for training
summary.body: We do not sell your data and do not use your content to train AI models.

sections.title: When you upload a video
blocks: The file goes to our private storage in the EU. We create a lighter preview copy, a waveform and a thumbnail so the editor stays fast. All of these belong to your account and are deleted with the project.

sections.title: When you use an AI feature
blocks: Some features need an AI model: transcription and captions use the audio, scene analysis uses still frames, and the assistant reads your request with the transcript. The part that is needed is sent to the provider, processed, and the result is returned to your project. The list of providers and where they are located is in the [Privacy Policy](/privacy#recipients).
Editing that does not need AI (cutting, trimming, effects, exporting) runs on our own servers.

sections.title: How long your projects stay

head: Plan
A project is deleted
rows: {{freeDays}} days after it was last modified
{{creatorDays}} days after it was last modified
Never while your subscription is active

blocks: We send one email at least 24 hours before deleting anything, listing the projects concerned. Opening or editing a project resets its timer. Vibed is an editor, not an archive: keep a copy of your final videos on your own device or drive.

list: **A project:** delete it from your dashboard. Its source files, previews and exports are removed with it, unless another of your projects uses the same file.
**Your account:** delete it from the [account page](/auth). Every file and record linked to it is removed, and the action cannot be undone.
**Your style profile:** view, download or reset it on [Your style](/style).
**A copy of everything we hold:** write to [{{email}}](mailto:{{email}}) and we will send it within one month.

faq.q: Can anyone at Vibed watch my videos?
faq.a: Only if you ask us to look at a project to help you, or if we must investigate a security issue or a legal request. We do not browse user content.

faq.q: Do you use my videos to improve your AI?
faq.a: No. Your content is processed to give you a result, not to train models, and our AI providers process it under their business terms.

faq.q: What if I cancel my Pro subscription?
faq.a: Your projects stay as they are, and the Free plan rule applies from then on: a project not modified for {{freeDays}} days is deleted, after an email reminder.

faq.q: What about people who appear in my videos?
faq.a: You are responsible for having their permission to film and publish them. Our face and voice detection only places faces in the frame and labels speakers; it does not identify anyone.

faq.q: Is my data stored outside Europe?
faq.a: Files and the database are stored in the EU and Switzerland. Some AI providers are in the United States and receive only what a feature needs, under the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or the Data Privacy Framework.
